summary: Merkley co-authored a September 2025 report with Van Hollen calling Israel's Gaza actions 'ethnic cleansing' and the US 'complicit,' and in November 2024 spoke on the Senate floor supporting Joint Resolutions to block offensive weapons sales to Netanyahu. KLCC noted his divergence from Wyden on weapons-sales votes; Vote for Peace rates him an Ally. His language stops short of 'genocide,' and his July 2025 remarks centered on humanitarian aid, but the resolution support and report co-authorship place him against US arms transfers to Israel.
